question: What flexibility is permitted in placing the worship materials and the superior practitioner during the offering?
premises: The worship material is mentioned as an item of the rite.
Placement is specified as both in nearness and in distance.
The superior practitioner is included alongside the worship material.
inference: Both the worship materials and the superior practitioner may be situated either near or far during the offering.
uncertainties: The exact ritual role of the uttarasādhaka in this context is not fully specified.
plain_english: The worship materials and the superior practitioner may be placed either nearby or at a distance.
